-- args --
@DIR@/Mod
-- want --
exit 0
-- stderr --
-- Mod/src/com/x/ConfigSession.java --
class ConfigSession {
  private final Map<String, Entry> map = new HashMap<String, Entry>();
  synchronized String issue(String id, String user) {
    map.put(id, new Entry(user, 0));
    return user;
  }
  synchronized void revoke(String id) {
    map.remove(id);
  }
}
